full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. Literal and complete source/ancestor context checks are separate.

measurementRules.rule: Q is the sum of calibrated net film mass at each unique first negative release under cp_release, after actual drying/conditioning. Include retained acetate support, image/emulsion and moisture once; exclude removable packing, rejected footage and removed destructive samples. Closing first-released FG is already included in Q.

Weigh same-state net strips directly. Counts/length/area need independently measured same-lot net unit mass or areal mass with sampling and uncertainty; record actual perforations/cuts. Do not infer kg from camera count, nominal frame count, envelope geometry, substrate thickness or a database secondary coefficient. A measured per-item mass is a collection result, never a guessed value.

Use whole as-supplied wet formulation mass once. Its water/active ingredient assays are non-additive subledgers. Independently measure actual added dilution water and any separately purchased adjustment chemical. Volume-to-mass needs the specific solution density at the measured state; water density is not another bath density.

Preserve raw units. Convert electricity kWh × 3.6 to MJ once before attribution. Integrate genuine rates over time; already integrated liquid/gas volumes receive no extra time multiplier. Match concentration to actual dry/wet gas volume, temperature/pressure and sampling state.

Keep full physical gross V and its native unit separate from attributed burden A and historical stock vectors. Each result references the one section8 normalization on Q or original Qc. H is an observation interval, not another divisor. Internal transfers cancel only as matched physical endpoints.

calculationRules.rule: Convert raw measurements before attribution: kWh × 3.6 = MJ; actual count × independently measured same-lot net item mass = kg; actual area × independently measured same-state areal mass = kg; liquid volume × independently measured solution density at recorded temperature = kg. Integrate a rate once; a cumulative volume is already integrated. Keep original units and uncertainty.

For each exchange i on a gross-receipt basis: A_prod_i = B_openRaw_i + B_openWIP_i + B_openNonWIP_i + B_new_i - B_closeRaw_i - B_closeWIP_i - B_closeNonWIP_i, after dedicated/virtual subdivision and justified residual attribution. All sets are disjoint and all components retain their native unit. B_new includes actual failed/zero-output/start-stop/idle/cleanup work. First-released FG is never a manufacturing Bclose term. Already-net consumption uses its documented equivalent bridge without repeating stock correction. Preserve unassigned burdens if no causal positive-Q cohort exists.

Retain full historical cohort vectors and physical opening/closing FG/package quantities. A_service_i is only actual new attributable service burden observed in H, including failed work, rewash and cleaning, linked to original Qc; it is not the full historic manufacture purchased again. Package acquisition/use/disposal history and unassigned pool vectors reconcile independently. Gross physical V is not multiplied by an economic or burden share.

Modeled result_i,c = A_i,c / original positive Q0,c once, after actual conversion and nonoverlapping attribution. Record physical observation V/Qt and actual provider quantity Ut once; if reported Qt/Q_analysis is explicitly physical and cannot be the full shared modeled numerator per cohort. Actual same-gate reference first_negative_release is exactly1kg. Production A_prod and newly observed services A_service remain separate; H is no divisor. Zero/unknown Q0 retains raw quantities and unresolved attribution.

At each gate reconcile opening stocks plus full actual receipts/uptakes against closing stocks plus full actual outputs/releases, with whole-wet or mutually exclusive component accounting. Internal bath/film/package handoffs cancel only with matched IDs and equal quantities. Keep total mass, H2O and relevant element ledgers independent of species/reaction equations; no guessed correction flow, dual-unknown residual fit, or stock term removed merely because a row exists.

measurementRules.rule: Q为按cp_release在真实干燥/调湿后每次唯一首次负片放行的校准净胶片质量之和。保留醋酸片基、影像/乳剂及水分仅计一次；排除可移除包装、拒收片段和移除的破坏性样片。期末已首次放行成品已包含在Q内。
直接称量同状态净片条。件数/长度/面积需独立实测同批净单位质量或面密度并保留采样和不确定性；记录真实齿孔/裁切。不得从相机数、标称画格数、包络几何、片基厚度或数据库次级系数推算kg。每件实测质量是采集结果，不能猜测。
整份供货湿制剂质量仅计一次，内含水/活性成分化验为非加和子账。真实另加稀释水及单独外购调整化学品独立计量。体积转质量需该溶液在实测状态下的密度；水密度不是其他槽液密度。
保留原始单位。电力kWh乘3.6仅换算一次为MJ，再归属。真实速率按时间积分；已积分气液体积不再乘时间。浓度与真实干/湿气体体积、温压和采样状态一致。
完整实物gross V及其原生单位，与归属负荷A及历史库存向量分开。每项结果引用第8节在Q或原Qc上的唯一归一化。H为观察期，不是另一个除数。内部转移仅作为匹配实物端点抵消。

calculationRules.rule: 归属前转换原始测量：kWh乘3.6为MJ；真实件数乘独立实测同批净单位质量为kg；真实面积乘独立实测同状态面密度为kg；液体体积乘记录温度下独立实测溶液密度为kg。速率仅积分一次；累计体积已积分。保留原单位及不确定性。

对毛接收基准下各交换i：A_prod_i = B_openRaw_i + B_openWIP_i + B_openNonWIP_i + B_new_i - B_closeRaw_i - B_closeWIP_i - B_closeNonWIP_i；先进行专属/虚拟细分及有理由的剩余归属。各集合互斥，各分量保留原生单位。B_new包含真实失败/零产出/启停/空转/清理工作。首次放行成品绝不作制造Bclose项。已净消耗采用有记录等价桥接，不再重复库存校正。没有因果正Q批群时保留未分配负荷。
保留完整历史批群向量及实物期初/期末成品/包装量。A_service_i仅为H内已观察真实新增可归属服务负荷，含失败工作、重洗及清洁，关联原Qc；不是再次采购完整历史制造。包装取得/使用/处置历史及未分配池向量独立核对。gross实物V不乘经济或负荷比例。
建模result_i,c = A_i,c除原正Q0,c一次，先真实换算及互斥归属。实物观察V/Qt及真实provider量Ut各记录一次；若报告Qt/Q_analysis须明示实物，不能成为每批完整共享建模分子。同门参考first_negative_release严格1千克。生产A_prod与新观察服务A_service分账，H不作除数。零/未知Q0保留原始量及未解归属。
各物理门以整湿或互斥组分核对：期初库存加全部真实接收/摄入，对应期末库存加全部真实输出/释放。内部槽液/胶片/包装交接仅凭匹配ID和相等数量抵消。总质量、H2O及相关元素账独立于物种/反应方程；不猜校正流、不残差拟合双未知、不因有卡片而删库存项。
